message.content:
Here’s a quick way to split only at the first “=” so you end up with `["hello", "good="]`:

```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # split at most once
print(parts)                 # ['hello', 'good=']
```

Using `split('=', 1)` tells Python to perform at most one split, leaving any remaining “=” characters in the second part.
